input.question: Which of the following statements about QuantLib::CashFlows is correct?

options.A: CashFlows is a template class parameterized on the cash flow type, and npv() is an instance method.
options.B: CashFlows can be instantiated and its npv() method called on an instance object.
options.C: CashFlows::npv() requires a YieldTermStructure handle rather than an InterestRate, and the class can be subclassed.
options.D: CashFlows::npv() can be called with a yield-based signature taking a Leg and an InterestRate, and CashFlows cannot be instantiated because all its constructors are deleted.
